period_note: Sourced directly from the bank's own primary quarterly interim financial statements ("Financial Statements for the First Quarter ended 31 March 2013 (Unaudited)", filename 'City_Bank_First_Quarterly_Report_2013.pdf'), recovered via Wayback Machine capture of the bank's original thecitybank.com/AnnualReport archive (this quarter predates the legacy.citybankplc.com file archive, which has no 2013 entries at all). Per project convention the SOLO ('Balance Sheet as at 31 March 2013' / unlabelled 'Profit and Loss Account for the First Quarter ended 31 March 2013') figures are used, not the explicitly-labelled 'Consolidated' panels. Arithmetically verified: Total liabilities 114,500,289,681 + Shareholders' equity 16,856,962,693 = Total assets 131,357,252,375 exactly; Net interest income 1,086,115,250 + Investment income 413,457,837 + Commission 245,526,232 + Other operating income 260,768,116 = Total operating income 2,005,867,435 exactly. Strong cross-validation: this filing's own 31-Dec-2012 Solo comparative column (Total assets 130,185,631,812) matches the dataset's existing 2012_Q4.json total_assets (130,186m) almost exactly, confirming both series are on a consistent Solo basis. Income-statement figures are cumulative-from-Jan-1 (identical to a discrete quarter for Q1 specifically). Non Funded Income is calculated as Commission/exchange/brokerage + Other operating income (both individually reported). NAV per share is not disclosed in the primary interim statement and is left out as a genuine gap.

source.source_page_lines: Single-page landscape layout (4 panels: Consolidated and Solo Balance Sheet/P&L/Cash Flow/Statement of Changes in Equity); scanned/image PDF with no usable text layer, read visually via page render (pdftoppm -r 150)
